name: Bloody Sacrifice applies its 15% healing-received aura (#2832)
contract: Bloody Sacrifice 705742 has a single effect in Spell.dbc: SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA with aura 118 SPELL_AURA_MOD_HEALING_PCT, BasePoints 14 + DieSides 1 = 15%, MiscValue 126, TargetA 1 and duration index 21 (permanent). It is registered on AuraEffect::HandleNoImmediateEffect and lives in Unit::SpellHealingBonusTaken, which reads GetMaxPositiveAuraModifier(SPELL_AURA_MOD_HEALING_PCT). The harness exposes no healing-taken metric - spell_healing_done calls SpellHealingBonusDone, the caster-side half - so this scenario locks the applied aura and its shipped amount rather than an observed heal. Two shipped oddities are recorded with the audit rather than fixed here: the record's ProcChance 5 is vestigial (aura 118 is not an isTriggerAura and the record's ProcFlags are 0, so SpellMgr generates no SpellProcEntry and nothing rolls 5%), and MiscValue 126 is ignored because the core's consumption of aura 118 applies no school filter.

steps.label: The talent is absent to begin with
The healing-received bonus is the shipped 15%
It is a permanent, beneficial aura
